pc88:local-84a8d9d450.description: NT-3's 1992 music disk for Active Gamers, the first of their collections to officially support both Sound Board II and the standard FM sound.
pc88:local-84a8d9d450.title: Juvenilias - NT-3 Music Disk

pc88:local-84ec0ef9d2.description: Five games, a jigsaw, a matching panel, a quiz, a crossword and a horoscope, each hosted by a girl aged 12 to 21.
pc88:local-84ec0ef9d2.title: Fantasy Rop

pc88:local-86380815e7.description: Looks like an RPG but is really a field-map adventure, full of absurd twists such as a station attendant turning out to be a CIA spy.
pc88:local-86380815e7.title: Attacker

pc88:local-86b16101fd.description: Second volume of Pasoket's Kagai Jugyou multiple-choice quiz series, themed on high-school girls, made by Nihon Art Media and sold under the label of the doujin software fair organizer in 1989.
pc88:local-86b16101fd.title: Kagai Jugyou Vol. 2 - Joshikousei-hen

pc88:local-87116f933e.description: Selected Sorcerian 5: Go! Doto's Triathlon, a parody race with huge prizes and no danger of death, and The Seal, the hunt for an escaped werewolf convict on a remote island.
pc88:local-87116f933e.title: Sorcerian Tsuika Scenario - Selected Sorcerian 5

pc88:local-875ea13e5f.description: Part of Kanai Karasawa's Kimochi Disk 2: the same looping photographed dance idea in a Japanese style, flanked by Nio guardian statues, with sampled sound produced through the beeper.
pc88:local-875ea13e5f.title: Kimochi Disk 2 - Odori

pc88:local-8787c3adae.description: Elein Soft's follow-up short adventure, Kanami-chan no Nichiyoubi: Kanami Saeki spends her Sunday, with Yumika returning and newcomer Mariko among the friends she can invite. Each run takes about ten minutes and branches toward different pictures.
pc88:local-8787c3adae.title: New Loaders Vol. 6

pc88:local-88266f5afc.description: This time the training is bomb disposal: in a maze that changes every game you have 40 minutes to find and defuse a bomb, which may be solid or liquid and must have its wires cut in the right order.
pc88:local-88266f5afc.title: Tiny Wasp II

pc88:local-88b339b5b5.description: Frostforest's FSD music sampler billed as Chaikuro's best background music, filled almost entirely with original tracks by Chaikuro and Monden.
pc88:local-88b339b5b5.title: FSD Sample Ongaku Shuu Vol. 7

pc88:local-8a4cfcddd6.description: Baseball played as a board game: take your team around the camp, season and other sheets on the dice against five computer teams.
pc88:local-8a4cfcddd6.title: Sugoroku Yakyuudou

pc88:local-8bc545ef6f.description: An action game in which you steer a small craft through zero-gravity mazes against the clock, fighting the craft's inertia to make it go where you want; Bardy Soft later reworked it with new graphics as its commercial debut, Hole Chaser.
pc88:local-8bc545ef6f.title: Nukeru Master XX

pc88:local-8be727dcdf.description: PC-88 port of Yasunori Takahara's MSX type-in from LOGiN's conversion corner (November 1986). In this real-time adventure you have slipped past the guards into the mansion and must find the hidden secret documents before time runs out, juggling a limited set of carried items.
pc88:local-8be727dcdf.title: Midnight Chase Part 2

pc88:local-8c9f60642f.description: A late (2006) Firecracker music disk built around Fishcafe's Onii-chan to Issho and many original tracks from guest musicians.
pc88:local-8c9f60642f.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 36 - Calling My Brother

pc88:local-8ce9cb4b55.description: A puzzle game starring a foul-mouthed evil rabbit who has to steer a girl lost in the forest into his house by placing fences.
pc88:local-8ce9cb4b55.title: Ribon Panic

pc88:local-8d1389fca7.description: Mink Label's four-disk table game crossing Old Maid with mahjong; the graphics are attractive, and completing a winning hand is notoriously hard.
pc88:local-8d1389fca7.title: Socian

pc88:local-8d379d1bed.description: A fiendish picture puzzle: swap tiles to complete several images at once, but each tile has two faces and flips every time it moves, and later stages split the pictures into more pieces.
pc88:local-8d379d1bed.title: Turning Gal

pc88:local-8e45f5b649.description: A blackjack card game from G.Create, makers of the FLAT music driver, starring a pair of blue-haired sisters animated in full colour, with Sound Board II music.
pc88:local-8e45f5b649.title: Duet

pc88:local-8e6d06118a.description: Orphe's best-of disk, packed with original and game music for the PC-88 (Sound Board II recommended); this Comic Market 45 edition differs from the earlier C43 one only in its comments and version.
pc88:local-8e6d06118a.title: Orphe Music Best in Comic Market 45

pc88:local-8f3c416a8f.description: A 33-track NT-3 music disk from Active Gamers (1991), the first of the circle's releases with full Sound Board II ADPCM support.
pc88:local-8f3c416a8f.title: So-and-so - NT-3 Music Disk

pc88:local-8f8ebcaa81.description: A chaotic adventure from Camadamia Soft: the girl every classmate admires has been kidnapped and the police are getting nowhere, so with school out you set off to rescue her yourself.
pc88:local-8f8ebcaa81.title: Uratima I

pc88:local-8fdf969fac.description: The high-school-girl volume of Marionet's Take Out series: Rui brings her friend Noriko to the school infirmary to join her and Kiyomi, and as before you progress by typing the words hidden behind blanked-out text. With three heroines it grew to two disks.
pc88:local-8fdf969fac.title: Take Out Vol. 4

pc88:local-8fe969f580.description: A simulation game from Creative H.A.T. in which you pilot mecha and wipe out the enemy, sold with a thick manga by FoZon explaining the side story.
pc88:local-8fe969f580.title: Chikyuu Boueigun Arbeit Butai

pc88:local-907236b647.description: The king will marry his daughter to whoever climbs his castle first: roll 1-5 to climb, but a 6 drops you to the start unless you have hammered in a stake, which takes a roll of 4 or more. Timing the stakes against your rival is the whole game.
pc88:local-907236b647.title: Hanayome Soudatsu - Shiro Nobori Game

pc88:local-918000a033.description: A short Elein Soft fantasy adventure: rescue Princess Eris from the witch Sadiral, helped by Amil, a timid girl who swears to obey you. A run takes about ten minutes, and replays are needed to see every picture.
pc88:local-918000a033.title: Erotic Magical Trip

pc88:local-927110fe0d.description: One of Firecracker's first five music disks, released together at 200 yen each and programmed in BASIC MML, which kept the sound modest but the track counts high.
pc88:local-927110fe0d.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 01 - We are Konamic Freaks

pc88:local-92cfa45448.description: A dice-driven board RPG from Dennou Kagaku Kenkyuujo, the circle behind the Dennou Tsuushin disk magazine: dice move your hero around the board and also settle every battle, much like Compile's Rune Master.
pc88:local-92cfa45448.title: Damages & Dice

pc88:local-9373354336.description: Part of Kanai Karasawa's multi-disk Kimochi Disk 2: pick Kanai or Karasawa and play look-this-way against him; win and he strikes a photographed come-hither pose with a recorded voice.
pc88:local-9373354336.title: Kimochi Disk 2 - Atchi Muite Hoi!

pc88:local-940934fc51.description: Firecracker music disk devoted to Tenshindo, mainly Martial Age and Yan Yan no Quiz Icchomae.
pc88:local-940934fc51.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 27 - Tenshindo Special

pc88:local-9421da146b.description: ALU Computer Arts' signature shooter: blistering speed and enemies that fill the screen with bullets, while your ship is nearly powerless and survives on a life gauge, so the game is all about dodging.
pc88:local-9421da146b.title: Phrenetic Shooting - Second Mission

pc88:local-94d4c34605.description: Go and gomoku on a nine-by-nine board, with a lesson mode that teaches the rules of Go.
pc88:local-94d4c34605.title: Goyugi

pc88:local-95a99dd08f.description: Magazine-style personality quizzes from eight girls.
pc88:local-95a99dd08f.title: Bishoujo wa Check ga Osuki

pc88:local-95f9e4a5ed.description: A fantasy adventure, often called the first doujin software: the hero searches a fairy-tale world for a bride, talking to people and animals and solving their problems.
pc88:local-95f9e4a5ed.title: Ningyo no Namida

pc88:local-969cc3afcf.description: A short Elein Soft adventure, Kanami-chan no Doyoubi: you guide the girl Kanami through her Saturday by simple choices, optionally calling over friends Michiyo, Yumika and Misano. A play takes about ten minutes, so repeat runs reveal the rest of the pictures; a bonus compatibility quiz unlocks extra art.
pc88:local-969cc3afcf.title: New Loaders Vol. 5

pc88:local-96acf4a77c.title: Chotto H na Graphics 3 - Milky Girls

pc88:local-9755c596c3.description: TKO Soft's Donjara tile game with its own scoring hands: when hero Susumu's childhood friend is carried off by a gang of tile players, he infiltrates their hideout and takes on its members, whose tiles and hands follow their hobbies, such as pro wrestling or progressive rock.
pc88:local-9755c596c3.title: Ponjara

pc88:local-97781249ab.description: Second Tabibito no Gakufu story from Team AB: while Rune is staying with a girl named Shurea, he clashes with the local count, again carried by its music.
pc88:local-97781249ab.title: Little Box

pc88:local-97bea4d8a3.description: A grim RPG: after his house burns, his father is murdered and his mother dies of grief, young Selen wanders off to make a living, fights monsters and uncovers the demon lord's plan. Battles are elaborate in a tabletop-RPG way and progress is saved with passwords.
pc88:local-97bea4d8a3.title: Selen

pc88:local-983fa780be.description: A word quiz of odd trick questions whose answers appear with some letters blanked out; each correct answer unlocks the next picture.
pc88:local-983fa780be.title: Love Mate

pc88:local-985005f82a.description: A two-disk blackjack game from Cream Soft: on Christmas a girl dressed as Santa drops by and promises a present if you can beat her friends, among them schoolgirl Kaori in her sailor uniform, Chisato, Nagisa and Sayo. The computer gets a little stronger with each opponent.
pc88:local-985005f82a.title: White Christmas 2

pc88:local-98722ec031.description: A parody of DB-Soft's Konya mo Asa made Powerful Maajan that swaps the mahjong for rock-paper-scissors against three girls, with a hidden character or two.
pc88:local-98722ec031.title: Konya mo Hitoban Powerful Janken

pc88:local-98b015e019.description: Frostforest's FSD music sampler with a small Romancing SaGa feature, followed by originals from GEPPEL, Osamu Ishikawa, NT-3, yon", Monden, KEN and Chaikuro.
pc88:local-98b015e019.title: FSD Sample Ongaku Shuu Vol. 3

pc88:local-98fbf37d5b.description: A one-on-one fighting action game against parodies of familiar anime characters, each attacking in a style that suits them and getting a knowing gag when beaten.
pc88:local-98fbf37d5b.title: Linna-chan no Jikenbo

pc88:local-997b30ec89.description: Tien Gow, the Chinese domino game, in which you bet on which of four hands is strongest, for one player against three set opponents or for four people.
pc88:local-997b30ec89.title: Tien Gow Pai

pc88:local-9982e5f66c.description: Active Gamers' four-disk 1993 RPG, a tale of devotion between siblings that was two years in the making and aimed at being the strongest doujin RPG on the PC-88. Its 34-track score was written in Sound Board II, standard FM and PSG versions, and it was among the last PC-88 titles still sold on TAKERU.
pc88:local-9982e5f66c.title: Undine

pc88:local-9a1c726225.description: First of Team AB's Tabibito no Gakufu series, a digital picture story in which Rune, dressed like Snufkin, is caught up in a small trouble in a village on his travels, with music placed front and centre.
pc88:local-9a1c726225.title: In the Dream

pc88:local-9a52d415b9.description: Third issue of Champion Soft's Zeta idol disk magazine, sold with a printed booklet and starring its regular cast of teen idol girls: a top-ten news corner, a date between a reader and idol Minaho, a jigsaw puzzle and more.
pc88:local-9a52d415b9.title: Zeta No. 3

pc88:local-9a574eef3f.description: A quiz made for the 1990 Osaka Flower Expo in which every question is Expo trivia; the prize for winning turns out to be not the girl on the title screen but the bizarre talking creature Hanazukin. Its Sound Board II music by CHEMOOL is unique to the PC-88 version.
pc88:local-9a574eef3f.title: Hanayaide Osaka

pc88:local-9c57481492.description: A Sengoku strategy game: five great warlords, among them Takeda Shingen and Uesugi Kenshin, compete through march, battle and intrigue phases taken in a random order each turn.
pc88:local-9c57481492.title: Gunyuu Souha

pc88:local-9d61a798ff.description: KOB soft's reverse Othello: the winner is whoever ends with the fewest pieces. Three opponents scattered across Japan's cities make up ten stages with different starting layouts, and the music supports Sound Board II.
pc88:local-9d61a798ff.title: Rinse

pc88:local-9d6f5f4a3b.description: LOGiN Soft's construction kit for field-map action RPGs, an ancestor of RPG Tsukuru sold through TAKERU in 1988: draw graphics dot by dot, lay out map chips and build your own game. Named after explorer Mamiya Rinzo; a sample game is included.
pc88:local-9d6f5f4a3b.title: Mamirin

pc88:local-9d8d2f9afe.description: A text adventure by Thinking Rabbit: four hundred years ago Queen Madeleine died in prison for trying to poison her father, yet her portrait shows no trace of evil; set out to learn the truth.
pc88:local-9d8d2f9afe.title: Madeleine

pc88:local-9d983ff467.description: A free bonus disk for answering the survey in Active Gamers' Infinitia, carrying NT-3's music from the enhanced PC-98 edition of Mysterious Love Token back over to the PC-88.
pc88:local-9d983ff467.title: Mysterious Love Token 98 - NT-3 Music Disk

pc88:local-9de742bbd9.description: The sixth of ONION software's 100-yen disks (1989), with four games by ONION, OSS, G-Create and Creative H.A.T., led by Cattle Mutilation, a mysterious game about aliens, cows and UFOs; another stars Hikkoshi-kun, a character known only from Shizuoka TV ads.
pc88:local-9de742bbd9.title: 100 Yen Disk No. 6

pc88:local-9e9585d0a7.description: Firecracker's tenth music disk, centred on Super Star Soldier and the first to drop the standard FM version for lack of space; it also slips in a tune from Hanayaide Osaka.
pc88:local-9e9585d0a7.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 10 - Super Star Soldier

pc88:local-9f6a762d8a.description: A DTB software magical-girl adventure: young Yuki visits an amusement park with friends and her fairy pet Pome, who vanishes; turning into Milky Pal and back, she searches the Ferris wheel, teacups and roller coaster and catches the pair who stole Pome.
pc88:local-9f6a762d8a.title: Milky Pal

pc88:local-a028df090c.description: The only music disk made by all of Orphe's members together, for Sound Board II: it has many tracks and full-colour scanned pictures, which pushed it onto two disks.
pc88:local-a028df090c.title: Orphe Music Disk Ongakukan

pc88:local-a2b3541c41.description: The 1990 finale of Elein Soft's fantasy series, told as a novel-style adventure: three years after rescuing and marrying Princess Eris, the hero has become king, until a woman from the kingdom's past steps out of a mirror and a witch turns out to be lurking inside his queen.
pc88:local-a2b3541c41.title: Erotic Magical Trip 3

pc88:local-a4de3fa713.title: Dai Hustle! SF Hare Hare Sanjuushi

pc88:local-a520827243.description: Firecracker's long-promised Dracula special: 51 tracks from the three Famicom Castlevania games and the Game Boy one, with plenty of documents.
pc88:local-a520827243.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 20 - Vampire Killer!!

pc88:local-a627ba6355.description: A music disk by Kashinohinoki and Unoafuku of Team AB, playing refined original tunes through their own driver, which squeezes extra voices and drum sounds out of the standard FM chip.
pc88:local-a627ba6355.title: Team AB Music Disk for 88 No. 1

pc88:local-a6c0ce96fb.description: A backgammon-like board strategy game from Creative H.A.T. whose field map changes every stage, so tactics must adapt.
pc88:local-a6c0ce96fb.title: Fon II

pc88:local-a732698d4d.title: Jigoku no Sata mo Nani Shidai - Ura-ban

pc88:local-a81fe7f0d7.description: A sample game for LOGiN Soft's early action-game editor, a forerunner of the Tsukuru series: your hero walks, crouches, jumps, swings a sword and hurls fireballs at enemies.
pc88:local-a81fe7f0d7.title: The Sword of Legend

pc88:local-a87527dd0b.description: A sliding 15-puzzle whose pictures and music, including a music mode, change when you insert a data disk.
pc88:local-a87527dd0b.title: Puzzle Shichauzo

pc88:local-a8dde75b55.description: A command-selection adventure from Unique's: guide Miyou, locked in Gyokukakuji temple as a test of courage, to find her way out.
pc88:local-a8dde75b55.title: Gyokukakuji 3-gai Seme

pc88:local-a8ee758088.description: A concentration game in which panels carry a picture on both sides and pairs must be matched face-down; fewer panels can move each stage, and a challenge mode allows two-player matches.
pc88:local-a8ee758088.title: Double Face

pc88:local-a905d2db16.description: Firecracker's third collection of guests' original music, including CHEMOOL's varied tracks for Nouten Densetsu and Osamu Ishikawa's Until the very end.
pc88:local-a905d2db16.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 25 - Original Music Special 3

pc88:local-aa578a3318.description: A tough falling-block puzzle from Frostforest in which you clear blocks by combining musical notes and rests, with a drill mode of set problems in the vein of Nazo Puyo.
pc88:local-aa578a3318.title: Key On

pc88:local-aac16c7308.description: A 1990 music disk from Kobe's Woodsman Club, running on Magical-DOS with the PMD sound driver.
pc88:local-aac16c7308.title: Woodsman Disk Vol. 3

pc88:local-ab65d78e0a.description: An ASCII action game later collected on the Disk ASCII SF game disk: steer Rocketman with careful bursts of thrust to move between floors and collect every flower on screen, avoiding enemies and transformers and never hitting the ceiling or falling too far.
pc88:local-ab65d78e0a.title: The Rocketman

pc88:local-ab6a347216.description: Starcraft's Japanese release of Sierra's Hi-Res Adventure #4, based on Homer's Odyssey: you sail to a magic land across the sea to bring back the golden fleece, getting past obstacles that only knowledge of Greek myth will solve.
pc88:local-ab6a347216.title: Ulysses

pc88:local-ab8cd403ef.description: Part of Kanai Karasawa's Kimochi Disk 2: ADPCM is loaded into memory, then frame-by-frame photographed dance animation streams from disk in an endless loop to MC Hammer.
pc88:local-ab8cd403ef.title: Kimochi Disk 2 - Dance

pc88:local-ac28261313.description: Firecracker's T-Square special music disk, arranging tracks from the fusion band.
pc88:local-ac28261313.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 21 - T-Square Special

pc88:local-ac83ef8dd4.description: A 1988 Lolita Soft adventure produced by Ikuko Ebata, drawn in 400-line high resolution and accepting romaji command input.
pc88:local-ac83ef8dd4.title: Nagareboshi no Namida

pc88:local-aca5cce1e3.description: Second Joker RPG, made entirely by one person: almost all text on screen, but with a carefully worked-out Dragon Quest-style scenario and music by Matsukui.
pc88:local-aca5cce1e3.title: Joker no Yabou 2

pc88:local-ae419d5091.title: Two Jewels in the Dungeon - The Lunar Sword II

pc88:local-ae8f1a8f3d.description: Firecracker music disk (1995) covering V.G. II, a piece made online on UNISON-BBS, and originals from the CD Alpha.
pc88:local-ae8f1a8f3d.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 32 - V.G.2 Complete Special

pc88:local-aeffccb8e5.description: A late PC-88 RPG from A-Inn, a circle better known for its racier titles: a familiar quest to rescue the hero's kidnapped younger sister, released on two disks in 1991.
pc88:local-aeffccb8e5.title: Ireen

pc88:local-afb48f2d0d.description: Firecracker music disk (1994) featuring Giga's Steam Hearts and Advanced V.G. plus the PC Engine Farland Story.
pc88:local-afb48f2d0d.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 31 - Steam Hearts Special

pc88:local-b055fb23be.description: Team Dangeroude's second Hidoi Disk (1994), whose highlight is the mini game Yuukai Daisakusen, alongside more of Yamazaki's runaway essays.
pc88:local-b055fb23be.title: Hidoi Disk Vol. 2

pc88:local-b15e4dceb8.description: A Seven Bridge card game whose underwear drawings were famously modelled on the Cecile mail-order catalogue, hence the title.
pc88:local-b15e4dceb8.title: Cecile

pc88:local-b171141a21.description: A 2009 Firecracker music disk of quiz-game tunes: Capcom's Quiz Nanairo Dreams, Sega's Answer x Answer and Tenshindo's Yan Yan no Quiz Icchomae.
pc88:local-b171141a21.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 38 - Rainbow x Answer

pc88:local-b2372bc2aa.description: Bishoujo Club's card battle game: each card has a power and a number of actions, and you beat an enemy when your die roll plus power tops theirs; buy weapons for specific characters at the shop between stages, and save strong cards with few actions as trumps.
pc88:local-b2372bc2aa.title: Semi Double

pc88:local-b262361eba.description: The second parody fighting game, pitting you against stand-ins for Noriko, DAICON, A-ko, Kiki and Totoro on suitably familiar backdrops.
pc88:local-b262361eba.title: Linna-chan no Jikenbo 2

pc88:local-b2ccdde7d4.description: A gallery of Adult Inn's 1987-1988 games, Ikenie no Machi and Bunny-chan no Himitsu among them, with a music mode.
pc88:local-b2ccdde7d4.title: Adult Inn '87-'88 Bangaihen

pc88:local-b3482fbcf4.description: Second issue of Omega, the older-skewing sibling of Champion Soft's Zeta disk magazines: guess which of four girls is the real model, follow college student Naoko through her day, and try an office-romance simulation.
pc88:local-b3482fbcf4.title: Omega No. 2

pc88:local-b40024ad29.description: ONION software's 1986 stage-by-stage action parody: to reach Rimi-chan, the girl who has just moved in next door, you face a run of trials that mash up Bouken Roman, Relics and other games.
pc88:local-b40024ad29.title: Rimi-chan no Kiken na Yoru

pc88:local-b407085538.description: A political simulation from DSK in which you play Japan's prime minister pursuing the annexation of Korea named in the title, battling public opinion while managing the political situation.
pc88:local-b407085538.title: Kankoku Heigou 1991

pc88:local-b43811c2df.description: Part of Kanai Karasawa's Kimochi Disk 2: Kanai sings Shizuka Kudo's MUGO-n Iroppoi into a microphone, reproduced as PCM synthesized on the PSG.
pc88:local-b43811c2df.title: Kimochi Disk 2 - Kanai-kun no Uta

pc88:local-b4687b594f.description: A follow-up picture disk to Champion Soft's adventure Keiko-chan no Himitsu that imagines what became of its heroine Keiko, released in nurse, office-worker and new-bride parts of about five pictures each. The disk asks for a five-digit password before it runs.
pc88:local-b4687b594f.title: Sono Go no Keiko-chan

pc88:local-b4ad3ac440.description: TKO Soft's poker game, played under its own unusual house rules; the manual promises that anyone can reach the ending.
pc88:local-b4ad3ac440.title: Atata Metcha Plus

pc88:local-b4ade00e5b.description: Fourth issue of Champion Soft's Zeta disk-and-magazine set: the booklet carries the four-panel comic Ganbare Maiko-chan and a profile of idol Miki, while the disk holds a spot-the-difference game, a jigsaw puzzle and a date with Kyoko.
pc88:local-b4ade00e5b.title: Zeta No. 4

pc88:local-b4cc2b6e70.description: A 15-puzzle of pictures such as Iczer-1 with the key directions reversed, which makes it confusing to solve.
pc88:local-b4cc2b6e70.title: Touble & Confusion

pc88:local-b4fee200b1.description: A sliding puzzle: a digitized video clip breaks into pieces, which you put back together; third in the Peep Show series.
pc88:local-b4fee200b1.title: Puzzle de Date

pc88:local-b5894668a2.description: Mad Pierrot's PC-88 conversion of an entry in Iron Gear's Nouten Chokugeki series of card games.
pc88:local-b5894668a2.title: Nouten Chokugeki! Gaiden

pc88:local-b855065667.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. A2 - Advanced V.G.2 Special Edition

pc88:local-b96a0cf277.description: A doujin vertical shooter in which your ship has several firing options; you blast through waves of enemies to a boss in each stage, and clearing a stage earns a reward picture.
pc88:local-b96a0cf277.title: Scottie

pc88:local-ba5552b1d5.description: Firecracker's second-anniversary music collection: two pieces from Mother including Bein' Friends, a large helping of Streets of Rage and other Sega music, many tracks from Cotton and assorted Konami tunes.
pc88:local-ba5552b1d5.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 24 - 2nd Anniversary!

pc88:local-bb0aab6d8f.description: A role-playing game in the style of Wizardry: the space pirate ship Weird sets out again when it learns that an evil power granting eternal life sleeps on the planet Maria, with a party of five.
pc88:local-bb0aab6d8f.title: Weird 2

pc88:local-bb3c7f5a75.description: A Go study program supervised by professional Koichi Kobayashi (then Judan), built to coach players working their way up to a 1-dan rank.
pc88:local-bb3c7f5a75.title: Igo Hyakka - Go to Shodan

pc88:local-bcff82c26a.description: The sequel to Irohanihoheto: the time-traveling warrior goes to Kyoto in 1582 to repair the history his last trip broke, so that the Edo shogunate lasts its three hundred years after all.
pc88:local-bcff82c26a.title: Gorakuin

pc88:local-be02986380.description: A time-travel comedy adventure: a student sneaks into school at night to fix a wrong test answer, is sent back to 1169 on the eve of the Genpei War, and must change history to fit his answer.
pc88:local-be02986380.title: Irowanioedo

pc88:local-bf711836a7.title: M&M Soft Omake Disk Part II

pc88:local-bf9cfc5aed.description: Ryokusui Sound Team's third Sound Board II music disk: covers from Thunder Cross, Darius II, Turbo OutRun and the MSX Castlevania, a series of heavy-metal experiments, and the ending theme of the circle's own Mind Storm.
pc88:local-bf9cfc5aed.title: RST Music Disk Vol. 03

pc88:local-c057aa7e61.description: A doujin falling-block puzzle game modelled on Tetris, offering the usual solo mode plus a head-to-head mode for two players.
pc88:local-c057aa7e61.title: Tetra Force Plus

pc88:local-c34fc50ff7.description: Charlie Soft's fifth music disk (1991): twenty FM pieces mixing covers of F-Zero's Mute City, ActRaiser, Dungeon Explorer, G-LOC, Tetris, Darius II and the Ys II opening with JR East station chimes and the circle's own tunes.
pc88:local-c34fc50ff7.title: Charlie Soft Music Disk Vol. 5

pc88:local-c5c523de00.description: A 1987 follow-up to Palcom's Mariko no Heya: you play rock-paper-scissors against Mariko, throwing with the 1, 2 and 3 keys, and each win moves you on to another picture of her.
pc88:local-c5c523de00.title: Mariko no Heya - Sorekara

pc88:local-c6d6e06ffc.description: Ryokusui Sound Team's seventh Sound Board II music disk, covering Area 88, MSX Salamander, Life Force, Rolling Thunder, Dark Fox, boss themes from Ys II, Ys III and Dragon Spirit, Syvalion, Silent Mobius and Misty Blue's staff roll.
pc88:local-c6d6e06ffc.title: RST Music Disk Vol. 07

pc88:local-c7a6999bf6.description: A doujin visual novel set in September 199X, in the middle of a war between gamers and non-gamers. To protect the city, the anti-gamer division AGID sends out 'game hunters', and the story follows one of them, Ura, on his mission.
pc88:local-c7a6999bf6.title: Uragame Hunter

pc88:local-c9b43f496e.description: After Miyake-jima erupts, you must flee before the next volcano blows in this text adventure. Your gear is chosen at the start and one wrong pick makes the ending unreachable, while an ambush by night bandits after a beautiful woman appears ends most runs fast.
pc88:local-c9b43f496e.title: Funka Survival Game

pc88:local-ca8a659661.description: A doujin take on Tetris with a twist: at any moment you can choose one piece type, and for a short while only that block will drop.
pc88:local-ca8a659661.title: Rumic Tetmas '90

pc88:local-ca9a3ca840.description: An adventure based on Jun'ichirō Tanizaki's novel Manji and its 1983 film, a love triangle between a married couple and the wife's lover.
pc88:local-ca9a3ca840.title: Manji

pc88:local-cb0625802e.description: Tsukumo's 1982 four-player mahjong game, its best-selling title of the era. Written in machine language, it ran far faster than the BASIC mahjong programs of the time; you discard with the letter keys and call riichi, pon, kan and ron on the function keys.
pc88:local-cb0625802e.title: Ultra Yonin Mahjong

pc88:local-cb71648c45.description: A Firecracker music collection headlined by FM arrangements from Taito's Metal Black and the shooter Phalanx, with music from other games filling out the disk.
pc88:local-cb71648c45.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 26 - Metal Black & Phalanx

pc88:local-cbc4437d3c.description: A vertical shooter that throws you straight into the first stage. Downed enemies drop upgrades, alternate weapons and front shields; the bullet shot spreads wider as it powers up while the twin laser grows stronger and faster, and every level ends with a boss.
pc88:local-cbc4437d3c.title: Unknown Variant 7

pc88:local-ccc251bb24.description: A survival dungeon crawler set in 2012, framed as a training simulation for two Galactic Federation soldiers picked to rescue a missing unit on planet Alphos. Play as Yuri or Eris, choose one of three guns, fight or flee from roaming robots and manage the energy that moving and special attacks use up while you search for the exit.
pc88:local-ccc251bb24.title: Red Shrew

pc88:local-cccfee647a.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 23 - Super Sonic Special

pc88:local-cce1909d1d.description: A doujin horizontal shooter in which you fire shots and missiles at ground targets and at enemy fighters flying below you. Your ship has a single life protected by a shield that drains when you are hit or touch enemies or the ground, and there are no power-ups.
pc88:local-cce1909d1d.title: Zaglev

pc88:local-ccf5097709.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 28 - Dedicated to Manabu Sato

pc88:local-cd9d855464.description: A doujin action game in which you pilot a UFO, dodging or shooting meteors while wrecking as many buildings and ground enemies as you can.
pc88:local-cd9d855464.title: MJ-12

pc88:local-cf41c76868.description: Active Gamers' first Sorcerian Sound Collection, Sound Board II arrangements of Falcom's Sorcerian: music from scenarios such as The Lost King's Staff, Tower of Thieves, Romancia, the Queen Mary, Ice Cave and Medusa's Head, plus the opening, Pentawa town, inn and ending themes.
pc88:local-cf41c76868.title: SSC1 - Sorcerian Sound Collection Vol. 1

pc88:local-cf8d66f442.description: A late entry in Firecracker's FM music collection series, released for the PC-88 in 2006 as a revival of the series, years after the platform's commercial life had ended.
pc88:local-cf8d66f442.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 35 - Magical Revival

pc88:local-d038196d40.description: A doujin block-pushing puzzle game in the vein of Sokoban: blue plus blocks go onto blue spots and orange minus blocks onto red ones, pushing opposite blocks together neutralises them, and lightning blocks swap a block's charge.
pc88:local-d038196d40.title: Puzlet 2

pc88:local-d0a258cd66.description: NT-3's 1991 music disk for Active Gamers: about thirty Sound Board II pieces, mostly originals including Holiness Story themes, a shorter set for the standard FM chip, and covers from Kiki's Delivery Service, Xak and other games.
pc88:local-d0a258cd66.title: Yume no Fantasia - NT-3 Music Disk

pc88:local-d12ef4d9a2.description: A doujin puzzle game in which a witch guides a rolling ball safely to the goal by summoning and dispelling blocks, and the ball can even roll over her head. Drops from too high shatter the ball or crush the witch, and the ball loses power whenever it bumps a block side-on or gets stuck.
pc88:local-d12ef4d9a2.title: Ferill

pc88:local-d24300f156.description: Firecracker's first collection written for the Sound Board II, a mix of FM arrangements from many games that again includes music from Ys.
pc88:local-d24300f156.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 04 - First Contact with S.B.2

pc88:local-d25c2a23f8.description: An extra scenario for Duel: the battle of Kawanakajima, as Takeda or Uesugi, with unit levels, arrow damage and dodging, ninja fireballs and an automatic battle option.
pc88:local-d25c2a23f8.title: Duel Kawanakajima

pc88:local-d29b2d1f22.description: The first-anniversary fifth issue (August 1987) of Champion Soft's ZETA disk magazine. The printed booklet mostly recaps past features and adds a CG lesson, while the disk holds a 100-question ZETA quiz, a beach pick-up guide and a lingerie catalogue of the ZETA girls.
pc88:local-d29b2d1f22.title: Zeta No. 5

pc88:local-d3b7416b18.description: Active Gamers' 1995 music disk led by NT-3 (Akito Monden), a bigger set than the first volume, made up mainly of original pieces such as Behind the Scheme and Marksman.
pc88:local-d3b7416b18.title: Imagical Musion Depot Vol. 2

pc88:local-d4401d1979.title: N80 and N88 Disk BASIC Utility Collection

pc88:local-d4d9f3a14e.description: Ryokusui Sound Team's eleventh Sound Board II music disk (1991), with covers from Rockman 3, Gradius III, Final Fantasy III, Dragon Quest IV, Parodius Da!, The Legend of Heroes, Megami Tensei II and a long Princess Maker set, plus several originals.
pc88:local-d4d9f3a14e.title: RST Music Disk Vol. 11

pc88:local-d4ed8ed6f1.description: An overhead-view adventure from 1988 in which a man explores a tower dungeon and the levels beneath it. There is no menu and no combat: you walk the corridors, trade items with characters who ask for them, and items are used automatically in the right spot to open new areas.
pc88:local-d4ed8ed6f1.title: Bargon no Paka Paka Shoubouken

pc88:local-d5bae97b78.description: A doujin disk compilation: a non-playable demo of a game, a personal quiz about game programming, a selection of music, a message from the developer and extra information.
pc88:local-d5bae97b78.title: Relief Soukangou

pc88:local-d5c916b9fc.description: Playing as My-chan, you race Paco and Kana-nee to catch more of the biscuits and doughnuts falling from above than they do before time runs out. It was sold in Technopolis Soft's Dream Pack, paired with an FM-7 board game.
pc88:local-d5c916b9fc.title: Sugar Factory

pc88:local-d6967ac001.description: A port of the MSX game: as Lila of the psychic S-SWAT squad, uncover the supernatural invasion of the town of Chinese Hill, in a role-playing game whose battles are played as action.
pc88:local-d6967ac001.title: Shiryou Sensen - War of the Dead

pc88:local-d722df59ec.title: Tien Gow Pai Special - Tougen no Utage II

pc88:local-d745697496.description: A doujin horizontal shooter in which you choose one of two attack types at the start; some enemies drop power-ups that strengthen your weapon or restore your shield energy, and each level ends with a boss.
pc88:local-d745697496.title: Lasting Road

pc88:local-d7c27d9ce4.description: A fiendish puzzle game: get little Hina out of the water by catching rising buoys, which merge into balls and back again, through levels that grow brutally hard.
pc88:local-d7c27d9ce4.title: Help

pc88:local-d8f4f4fbfa.description: A 1991 music disk by Thomas Brown with thirty tracks, mostly original pieces and short game jingles for clears, misses and game overs, plus a Euro-style arrangement of Nobunaga's Ambition and a Brain Marker mountain theme.
pc88:local-d8f4f4fbfa.title: Sound Castle 1

pc88:local-d910a84701.description: The second Sorcerian Sound Collection from Active Gamers, arranging Sound Board II versions of music from Sorcerian's add-ons: the first extra scenario set, every chapter of Sengoku Sorcerian from Takeda Shingen to Tokugawa Ieyasu, Pyramid Sorcerian, and the utility disk's menu and quiz tunes.
pc88:local-d910a84701.title: SSC2 - Sorcerian Sound Collection Vol. 2

pc88:local-d958d6f701.description: A Japanese-style doujin adventure from Specters: after being hit by a truck, the hero is handed a second chance at life by a demon, on the condition that he win himself a girlfriend before his time runs out.
pc88:local-d958d6f701.title: Nirvana

pc88:local-da0676ac2e.description: Exiz's first music disk, made up entirely of music from the circle's own games.
pc88:local-da0676ac2e.title: Exiz Music Disk Vol. I - Prelude

pc88:local-da53ac84a1.title: 88 no Ikenai Sekai - Yousei no Yakata

pc88:local-da894d83ce.description: A doujin platform puzzler mixing Rodland and Solomon's Key: Mig must collect every fruit and item before time runs out, conjuring blocks that lift her up and serve as brief footholds, using hourglasses to stop time and feathers to walk on air, and riding certain enemies while avoiding any other contact.
pc88:local-da894d83ce.title: Mig - The Fantastic Adventure

pc88:local-db4fd5c442.description: A picture puzzle: lay cards on the board one at a time to rebuild a picture within a set number of moves, over ten pictures, with an editor for your own.
pc88:local-db4fd5c442.title: Carrot

pc88:local-db9edafead.description: A doujin action puzzle game starring the young witch Crim, who must gather every key and leave through the door while avoiding wandering enemies. Her wand can blow away or stun only some of them, others shoot when she comes into view, and every sixth stage brings a comic Crim Theatre scene or a coffee break.
pc88:local-db9edafead.title: Crim

pc88:local-dbb4d9e79f.description: A doujin Japanese-style adventure set in a high school where strange occurrences suddenly break out, leaving you to find out what has happened to its students.
pc88:local-dbb4d9e79f.title: Memory

pc88:local-dbf7e62566.description: A compilation of four small games, each a simplified version of a Game Arts title.
pc88:local-dbf7e62566.title: Game Arts Basic-Game

pc88:local-dc3cb4215f.description: A Firecracker music collection devoted to Namco, made up of FM arrangements of the company's classic game music.
pc88:local-dc3cb4215f.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 06 - The Golden Age of Namco

pc88:local-dc6f848fa2.description: A doujin RPG set in the many-floored Tower of Ashura, which you climb while fighting monsters, gaining levels and talking to the characters you meet.
pc88:local-dc6f848fa2.title: Ashura no Tou

pc88:local-dc989cb3f0.description: A doujin adventure: when Lia's mother, an aspiring prima donna, falls ill, Lia must take her place, helped by her doll Tia, which comes to life.
pc88:local-dc989cb3f0.title: Lime Light

pc88:local-dcd2a8d019.description: The first Sound On-Ten music disk from Yanbaru Kuina: arcade covers from Thunder Cross, Fantasy Zone, Gradius II, Galaxy Force II, Power Drift, The Ninja Warriors and Dragon Spirit, Ys endings, and a run of originals by Gal-kichi.
pc88:local-dcd2a8d019.title: Sound On-Ten Vol. 1

pc88:local-dce39d94c1.description: Four card games, blackjack, poker, seven bridge and baccarat, played for chips that you donate to disaster areas around the world.
pc88:local-dce39d94c1.title: Trump Aid

pc88:local-ddb1103908.description: A 32-track 1991 music disk from C.N. Products covering Operation Tomato, arcade Gradius II, Misty Blue, The Scheme, five Dragon Spirit stages, Snatcher, OutRun, Sorcerian, Syvalion and TwinBee, alongside originals such as Pessimistic Pierrot and Lucifer Field.
pc88:local-ddb1103908.title: Captain-NEO's Music Disk 2 - Candy Rock

pc88:local-e023ab75de.title: Jigoku no Sata mo Nani Shidai

pc88:local-e0cbf6062d.description: The second issue of ZETA, Champion Soft's 'graphic idol magazine' sold as a floppy disk plus printed magazine, presenting fictional idols through profiles and photo-style picture spreads. Several of the series' editors later worked at Alice Soft.
pc88:local-e0cbf6062d.title: Zeta No. 2

pc88:local-e1414a9623.description: The first music disk from Hoehoe Team 199X, made up of twelve original compositions with titles such as Wonder World, Planetarium, Death Trap, Day-dreamer and Roaring Hero!
pc88:local-e1414a9623.title: Hoehoe Team 199X Music Disk Vol. 1 - Explosion

pc88:local-e1b3e96488.description: The fifth of Frostforest's FSD sample music collections, a set of FM pieces that includes Dragon Quest music, shown with a picture of Fatal Fury's Terry Bogard.
pc88:local-e1b3e96488.title: FSD Sample Ongaku Shuu Vol. 5

pc88:local-e1e54e41f4.description: A side-scrolling shooter: in 1999, alien creatures attack science headquarters, and you fly the Super Heli to destroy them, scoring more for those that have transformed.
pc88:local-e1e54e41f4.title: Super Heli Dai Panic

pc88:local-e2b24592d8.description: Group R204's first doujin shooter, a horizontal scroller in which enemies drop power-ups and you can switch firing modes at any time, upgrading each mode separately. It is known for steep difficulty; the set includes the original monochrome release plus colour Kaiteiban and Tiny-ban revisions, and it was later ported to PC-98.
pc88:local-e2b24592d8.title: Melt Down

pc88:local-e2dcc01dd4.description: The sequel to the 2011 doujin roguelike Joker no Yabou 2: you begin as the mighty Joker, but your level drops after every major fight or story event, and unlike its predecessor it carries plenty of dialogue and cutscenes.
pc88:local-e2dcc01dd4.title: Joker no Yabou 3

pc88:local-e38265b037.description: Infocom's Zork trilogy on PC-88: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire, Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz and Zork III: The Dungeon Master, all played as English text adventures with typed commands and no graphics.
pc88:local-e38265b037.title: Zork I-III

pc88:local-e43a6054be.description: A doujin Japanese-style adventure set in the year 20XX, when a virus has left every man gravely ill and a heroic 'Fighting Nurse' sets out to find the cure.
pc88:local-e43a6054be.title: Tatakae Kangofu-san

pc88:local-e512b7d18a.description: The fourth 'Original Special' in Firecracker's music collection series, featuring the circle's own compositions and a title picture of Samurai Shodown's Nakoruru.
pc88:local-e512b7d18a.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 30 - Original Special 4

pc88:local-e55c14b616.title: PC-8801-23 Sound Board II N88 BASIC system disk

pc88:local-e591e90520.description: A port of the PC-98 mahjong game, with four-player tables, score records and opponents with their own habits; it needs a 64 KB RAM expansion.
pc88:local-e591e90520.title: Jangou 1

pc88:local-e5b7e1af1b.description: The sixth of Frostforest's FSD sample music collections, given over largely to FM renditions of Final Fantasy V music.
pc88:local-e5b7e1af1b.title: FSD Sample Ongaku Shuu Vol. 6

pc88:local-e6b05d8084.description: A strategy game that sticks close to history, built around the Shinsengumi's street battles with anti-shogunate ronin. The corps splits into two squads to fight a steady stream of enemies, and real members such as Kondo Isami and Okita Soji appear.
pc88:local-e6b05d8084.title: Shinsengumi

pc88:local-e7a38b3803.description: You play a schoolboy trying to land a date with one of the girls at your school.
pc88:local-e7a38b3803.title: Cucumber

pc88:local-e90698c193.description: A strategy take on Kurosawa's Seven Samurai: bandits raid a Warring States village, and you pick yourself plus six warriors from 32 samurai with their own stats, then use the terrain, bamboo barricades and troop placement to hold off the raiders.
pc88:local-e90698c193.title: Shichinin no Samurai

pc88:local-e9e530c1cd.description: A vertically scrolling doujin shooter from Group R204, the follow-up to its Melt Down. Shootable containers hold power-ups and weapons, and choosing between the fast shot, enemy-seeking homing missiles and the slower but strongest blast is the key; many enemies can also fire backwards. It was later ported to PC-98 and PC-6001mkIISR.
pc88:local-e9e530c1cd.title: ReFight

pc88:local-ec1e1b94ec.description: A doujin Japanese-style adventure that you advance by picking commands such as look, talk and even kiss.
pc88:local-ec1e1b94ec.title: Gaia no Kiba

pc88:local-ecfa135d29.description: A command game with minigames such as a maze escape, river rafting, painting, a memory test and number guessing; F10 swaps the screen for an English textbook.
pc88:local-ecfa135d29.title: Girlfriend Yumiko

pc88:local-edc7001521.title: Teiki Test Taisakuhen - Horizon Chuu 2 Shita

pc88:local-ee633bc2bb.description: An NT-3 music disk from Active Gamers split into a 'main dish' of 23 original pieces, among them a Holiness Story III theme and the title track, and a 'dessert' of 17 extras such as loading jingles and rejected tunes.
pc88:local-ee633bc2bb.title: Yoake no Merry-go-round

pc88:local-ef3c195dda.description: A doujin dungeon-crawling RPG: a vampire is terrorising a nearby town by seducing its women, some of whom now serve as his guards, and you play the knight sent to end his reign.
pc88:local-ef3c195dda.title: Vampire - Yoru no Kizoku

pc88:local-efee3e6a73.description: A doujin falling-block game closely modelled on Tetris. In the main Moscow mode pieces cannot be rotated but can be dropped instantly, while a regular mode, unlocked by pressing the blocks on the menu, allows rotation but no instant drop.
pc88:local-efee3e6a73.title: Moscow

pc88:local-f01ddf9304.description: A Firecracker music collection built mostly around music from outside video games, though some game tracks still appear.
pc88:local-f01ddf9304.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 13 - Out of Game Music

pc88:local-f0a3f5d78b.description: Active Gamers' 1992 command-style RPG, first in the Holiness Story series. You are a fighter battling rivals at a training ground in Dragon Quest-style turn-based fights and buying equipment to grow stronger; character creation opens with trivia questions about Dragon Quest and Final Fantasy.
pc88:local-f0a3f5d78b.title: Holiness Story

pc88:local-f0d127ca1c.description: An action game in six volumes: chase twenty schoolgirls in real school uniforms up a ladder, dodging falling buckets, brooms and erasers.
pc88:local-f0d127ca1c.title: Sailor-fuku Bishoujo Zukan

pc88:local-f1aebf8593.title: Blue Blood Music Disk Vol. 7 - Gradius Special

pc88:local-f3bd8b5634.description: Selected Sorcerian 3: The Cursed Ruins, where a bard's tale pulls you into the story, and the grand-prize winner The Temple of Time.
pc88:local-f3bd8b5634.title: Sorcerian Tsuika Scenario - Selected Sorcerian 3

pc88:local-f43c6b8db0.description: A CG collection of manga- and anime-style character pictures drawn by the Denken Soft circle itself.
pc88:local-f43c6b8db0.title: Denken CG Shuu

pc88:local-f65d7ad310.description: A construction kit for building your own Wizardry-style 3D dungeon RPGs. Its complete program listing was printed in the April 1987 issue of LOGiN magazine, and a disk version was sold through Takeru vending machines.
pc88:local-f65d7ad310.title: Dungeon Manjiro

pc88:local-f74f4a4f9e.description: A Firecracker music collection headlined by the soundtrack of the PC-98 game Briganty, alongside music from other games, an arrangement of Neon Genesis Evangelion's opening A Cruel Angel's Thesis and Yuri Shiratori's song Caramel Pop.
pc88:local-f74f4a4f9e.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 33 - Briganty Sound Tracks

pc88:local-f7649e7099.description: Mahjong against Chin-san, who carries the tiles to the table himself, with koi-koi hanafuda on the same disk.
pc88:local-f7649e7099.title: Chin-san Mahjong & Hanafuda Koi Koi

pc88:local-f77c3cf60f.description: A doujin sugoroku board game with RPG rules for up to four human or computer players: roll your way to the end of the board, slaying monsters for experience, buying equipment at shop squares and recovering on healing squares, until you are strong enough to beat the dragon waiting at the goal.
pc88:local-f77c3cf60f.title: Sugoroku Pon

pc88:local-f82af3d8eb.description: A plain-looking music library holding the soundtracks of all three PC-88 Ys games, with each track's name and composer listed.
pc88:local-f82af3d8eb.title: Ys Music Library

pc88:local-f877f7fe48.description: A carrier battle game: command the nuclear carrier Enterprise and three escorts, launching aircraft and tracking the enemy on radar to break through its defenses.
pc88:local-f877f7fe48.title: Enterprise

pc88:local-f95ee8453c.description: A doujin Sound Board II music disk with FM covers from a wide range of games, chosen from a menu that greets you with a spoken voice.
pc88:local-f95ee8453c.title: SOS for Sound Board II

pc88:local-fa10e765a8.description: Mahjong against the odd old man Chin-san, who slowly carries the tiles to the table himself. It won a prize in I/O magazine's first program contest and ran on PC-6001mkII, PC-6601 and PC-8801mkII; only the PC-6001 version speaks, using its speech chip.
pc88:local-fa10e765a8.title: Chin-san Mahjong

pc88:local-fa417d72f2.description: A vertical science-fiction shooter in which you destroy turrets and enemy fighters, collect power-ups and finish each stage against a boss.
pc88:local-fa417d72f2.title: Attacker Vanguard

pc88:local-fb63f9a4d4.description: A memory game: memorize a nine-digit code and key in the digits asked for.
pc88:local-fb63f9a4d4.title: Platonic Love

pc88:local-fb76c59dbe.description: A doujin action RPG in the Gauntlet mould: pick one of four characters and descend floor by floor, fighting monsters, gathering usable or equippable items and finding the stairs. Health returns by resting, potions or a paid healer, and hunger steadily drains you unless you eat the food you find.
pc88:local-fb76c59dbe.title: Zaxy

pc88:local-fbd12fa77e.description: A digitized picture collection of a girl's private life, with decorations and music.
pc88:local-fbd12fa77e.title: Sexy Orange

pc88:local-fd55c6aee9.description: A detective adventure: Keisuke Yuki, a fresh graduate with a self-styled detective agency and no clients, takes on a student's suicide and finds a bigger case behind it.
pc88:local-fd55c6aee9.title: Lonely Heart

pc88:local-fdeda17eb3.description: An early Firecracker music collection dedicated to PC-88 games, made up largely of arrangements from Falcom's Ys and Ys II.
pc88:local-fdeda17eb3.title: Firecracker Music Collection Vol. 03 - Dedicated to 88Games

pc88:local-febba2dbe5.description: A doujin platform puzzle game in which Miki-san must gather every piece of cake to make the exit appear; bonus items sometimes pop up that grant an extra heart or warp her to another level.
pc88:local-febba2dbe5.title: Miki-san Jump! - Easy Type

pc88:moby-10033.description: An expedition role-playing game: lead a team of four explorers into the Amazon to map lost ruins.
pc88:moby-10033.title: Expedition Amazon

pc88:moby-10040.description: A colorful shooter: fend off dagger-throwing millipedes, ants and other bugs.
pc88:moby-10040.title: Bug Attack

pc88:moby-10067.description: Solitaire poker: build poker hands in a grid of cards.
pc88:moby-10067.title: Solitaire Poker

pc88:moby-115841.description: A text adventure: the villain Voar has stolen the wizard's mirror, and the kingdom of Starbury is in peril.
pc88:moby-115841.title: The Coveted Mirror

pc88:moby-116585.description: An isometric shooter: a desperate strike against the alien foe attacking humanity's last outpost.
pc88:moby-116585.title: Polar Star

pc88:moby-117794.description: A 3D action game of steering aircraft around a looping course.
pc88:moby-117794.title: DIRES: giger・loop

pc88:moby-119402.description: An arcade game starring a tanuki who throws a bouncing ball at enemies.
pc88:moby-119402.title: Chobin

pc88:moby-119448.description: A business simulation that won Bothtec's first programming contest.
pc88:moby-119448.title: Business Tour

pc88:moby-119462.description: A 3D driving game that won Bothtec's first programming contest.
pc88:moby-119462.title: Free Way

pc88:moby-119799.description: An adventure based on Rumiko Takahashi's Maison Ikkoku: a student tries to win over the boarding house's young manager.
pc88:moby-119799.title: Maison Ikkoku

pc88:moby-119833.description: A text adventure: a terrorist threatens to destroy a city with a nuclear weapon.
pc88:moby-119833.title: Critical Mass

pc88:moby-130011.description: An arcade wrestling game for one or two players, with eight wrestlers to choose from.
pc88:moby-130011.title: Appoooh

pc88:moby-13526.description: An action role-playing game: a lone hero is foretold to save the people of Hydlide from the evil that descended on them.
pc88:moby-13526.title: Super Hydlide

pc88:moby-14770.description: A sci-fi action game: board a robot ship and sabotage it from within.
pc88:moby-14770.title: Voyager I: Sabotage of the Robot Ship

pc88:moby-14775.description: An operational World War II wargame: a German defense along the Dnieper River.
pc88:moby-14775.title: Dnieper River Line

pc88:moby-14886.description: A laser puzzle: rotate mirrors to guide a beam through each level to the receiver.
pc88:moby-14886.title: Deflektor

pc88:moby-14942.description: A sci-fi strategy game: command Space Station Zulu and its crew of 43, orbiting a gas giant.
pc88:moby-14942.title: Space Station Zulu

pc88:moby-149498.description: A graphical adventure based on the 1980 film The Gods Must Be Crazy.
pc88:moby-149498.title: Happy Bushman

pc88:moby-149959.description: A course add-on for Albatross with two professional courses.
pc88:moby-149959.title: Albatross Expansion Course: Expert Course

pc88:moby-149960.description: A course add-on for Albatross with two visual courses.
pc88:moby-149960.title: Albatross Expansion Course: Visual Course

pc88:moby-149964.description: A course add-on for Albatross with Arctic and Antarctic courses.
pc88:moby-149964.title: Albatross Expansion Course: World Course

pc88:moby-149966.description: A course add-on for Albatross featuring the Oak Hills Country Club.
pc88:moby-149966.title: Albatross Prestigious Course I: Oak Hills Country Club

pc88:moby-149968.description: A course add-on for Albatross featuring the Jun Classic Country Club in Japan.
pc88:moby-149968.title: Albatross Prestigious Course II: Jun Classic Country Club

pc88:moby-15551.description: An action shooter: a tank burrowing through an underground maze fights the creatures living there.
pc88:moby-15551.title: Driller Tanks

pc88:moby-156723.description: A map add-on for Daisenryaku with sixteen maps based on real locations.
pc88:moby-156723.title: Strategic Confrontation: Map Collection

pc88:moby-15931.description: A first-person role-playing game: recover the Golden Seal stolen by the Dark Lord.
pc88:moby-15931.title: Miracle Warriors: Seal of the Dark Lord

pc88:moby-161042.description: A Japanese text adventure based on Lewis Carroll's Alice's Adventures in Wonderland.
